post.description: Accepts a member invite: checks the emailed code (with `reset`, a password-reset code, which sets the password itself), sets the password, marks the email verified and signs in. Sets the HttpOnly session cookie. If a step after the code check fails, the error is `invite_incomplete` (or `weak_password`) with `error.accept_ticket`: send it back in place of `code` to finish. A pending sign-in that has expired doesn't fail the accept: `redirect` is then Studio's address.

200.description: Signed in: `next` is `done`, the session cookie is set

400.description: The body is malformed, the code or ticket is wrong, or the user is inactive with no open invite (`invalid_request`), or the password is refused (`weak_password`, with `accept_ticket` once the code was spent)

403.description: The member is suspended (`member_suspended`): the invite is accepted and the password set, but there is no sign-in until an admin reinstates them

410.description: The invite expired (`invite_expired`) or was revoked (`invite_revoked`)

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: Zitadel is unavailable (`unavailable`), or a step after the code check failed (`invite_incomplete`, with `accept_ticket`)

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's email (needs the `Chelabase-User` token). With verification on, a code is emailed and the email is unverified until `verify-email`.

401.description: No user token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

409.description: The email is taken (`email_taken`), it is the user's email already (`conflict`), or app users are off (`app_users_disabled`)

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

503.description: Zitadel or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Changes the signed-in user's password (needs the `Chelabase-User` token) and returns a new session; every other session of the user ends.

401.description: The current password is wrong (`invalid_credentials`), no user token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The new password is weak (`weak_password`), or the body has the wrong fields (`invalid_request`)

503.description: Zitadel or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: The public keys app access tokens are signed with, so an app's own server can verify them. Needs no key.

503.description: App users are not configured: `unavailable`

post.description: Emails a password-reset code. Answers the same whether or not the account exists.

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Sets a new password with the emailed reset code and ends every session of the user.

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The code is wrong (`invalid_code`), the password is weak (`weak_password`), or the body has the wrong fields (`invalid_request`)

503.description: Zitadel or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new session. The old refresh token stops working (presenting it again later revokes the session).

403.description: The user is deactivated or locked: `user_inactive`

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: Zitadel or the orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Signs an app user in with email and password.

401.description: Wrong email or password (`invalid_credentials`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

post.description: Ends the session of the `Chelabase-User` token, or, without one, the session of the refresh token in the body.

401.description: Neither a user token nor a refresh token (`user_token_invalid`), or no valid public key (`unauthorized`)

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: The body has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Creates an app user and their users-table row. With email verification off, signs them in; with it on, emails a code and returns no tokens.

201.description: Signed up: a session (verification off) or a pending sign-up (verification on)

409.description: App users are off (`app_users_disabled`), or the email is taken and verification is off (`email_taken`)

415.description: The body is not JSON: `invalid_request`

422.description: Invalid input (`invalid_request`), a weak password (`weak_password`), a `data` column sign-up can't set (`unknown_column`) or a table constraint (`constraint_violation`)

503.description: Zitadel, the orchestrator or the database is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: The signed-in app user (needs the `Chelabase-User` token).

post.description: Looks up a pending sign-in and reports whether sign-up is asked for and allowed. Sets no cookie.

410.description: This sign-in has expired or is unknown: `sign_in_expired`

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: Zitadel is unavailable: `unavailable`

get.description: Whether this instance is unclaimed, so the sign-up page asks for the setup code. Sets no cookie.

503.description: The sign-up gate is unavailable: `unavailable`

post.description: Describes an open invite for the accept page: who invited the visitor, and to which workspace. The invite link's own token (`t`) is the credential, so this spends no Zitadel code. It is a POST so that the user id and the token are never in a URL. A closed (accepted, revoked or expired) invite, a wrong or missing user or token, and a malformed value all answer the same `not_found`.

200.description: The invite is open and the token matches

400.description: The body is not well-formed JSON: `invalid_request`

404.description: `not_found`: no open invite with this user and token

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

503.description: The orchestrator is unavailable: `unavailable`

200.description: Signed in (`done`, with the session cookie set and the step cookie cleared) or waiting for the email code (`verify`, with the step cookie set)

get.description: Studio's runtime config: the Zitadel issuer, Studio's client id, the project and org ids, the API URL and Studio's host. Public; cacheable for 60 s.

404.description: Studio's ids aren't configured here (a dev Studio uses its build values): `not_found`

503.description: The bootstrap hasn't written the ids yet: `unavailable`

post.description: Checks the emailed code. Reads the HttpOnly step cookie; on success sets the HttpOnly session cookie and clears the step cookie.

200.description: Email verified and signed in: `next` is `done`, the session cookie is set and the step cookie cleared

400.description: The body is malformed (`invalid_request`) or the code is wrong (`invalid_code`)

410.description: This sign-in has expired or is unknown: `sign_in_expired`

415.description: The body is not JSON (wrong content type): `invalid_request`

422.description: The body is JSON but has the wrong fields: `invalid_request`

503.description: Zitadel is unavailable: `unavailable`

acceptTicket.description: From an `invite_incomplete` error: retries the steps after the (spent) code.

authRequest.description: The pending sign-in to finish; without it the answer sends the browser to Studio.

code.description: The invite code from the link. Send this or `acceptTicket`.

reset.description:
The link's `reset=1`: `code` is a password-reset code (a person who already had a way to
sign in, whom Zitadel gives no invite code). It sets the password itself.

user.description: The Zitadel user id from the invite link.

AppJwks.description: The app token signing keys (JWKS, RFC 7517).

AppSession.description: A signed-in session: a short-lived access token and the refresh token that renews it.

data.description:
Values for the users table's own columns. Only columns with
`GRANT INSERT (column) ON <users table> TO authenticated` are accepted.

AppSignUpPending.description: A sign-up that waits for the emailed code: no tokens yet.

AppSignUpResult.description: Sign-up's answer: a session (verification off) or a pending sign-up (verification on).

AppUser.description: An app user as the flows show them.

AuthRequestInfo.description: What the sign-in page needs to know about the pending sign-in.

signUp.description:
The visitor asked to create an account (`prompt=create`) and this instance allows it:
Studio goes to its sign-up page. `false` for a refused sign-up request too, which then
lands on the plain sign-in page.

signUpAllowed.description:
This instance takes sign-ups (open sign-up is on, or the tenant has no member yet and a
setup code is configured): the sign-in page may offer "Create account". Always `false`
in platform mode.

DescribeInviteBody.description: Both fields default to empty, so a missing one is a `not_found` like a wrong one.

t.description: The invite token from the invite link.

user.description: The Zitadel user id from the invite link.

ErrorBody.description:
The documented shape of the `error` object. Some codes add extra keys (for example
`keys`), which are documented per code.

ErrorCode.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Serialises as snake_case.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The schema error responses reference: `{"error": ErrorBody}`.

InstanceInfo.description: What the sign-up page needs to know about this instance.

setupRequired.description:
The instance is unclaimed (its tenant has no member yet): the first sign-up needs the
setup code that `chelabase-init secrets` printed. `false` once anyone is in, without a
configured code (then no first sign-up is taken at all), and in platform mode.

InviteDescription.description: Who invited the visitor and to what.

inviter_name.description:
The inviter's display name; their email's local part when they have none; `An admin` with
neither (a machine user).

tenant_name.description: The workspace the invite is to.

oneOf.description: Signed in: send the browser to `redirect` (Zitadel's callback for the pending sign-in).
The email isn't verified: show the code step.

NextStep.description: What the sign-in pages do next, as `{"next": "done", "redirect": …}` or `{"next": "verify"}`.

setupCode.description:
The setup code that `chelabase-init secrets` printed: the first sign-up of an unclaimed
instance needs it (case and dashes don't matter). Ignored once the instance is claimed.

StudioConfig.description:
Studio's runtime config: the six public values it signs in with. Nothing else is here (no
PAT, key or secret): it is public and cached.

projectId.description: The `chelabase` project id (the API audience Studio asks for).
